Based on the council's outbuilding guidance, a garden shed under 2.5 metres high, set behind the front wall of the house and covering less than half the garden, does not usually need a planning application.

- **Conservation areas and listed buildings** have different rules, so a shed there may need an application even if it's small.

If you give me your full address, I can check whether any of these constraints apply. If you already have a planning application reference, I can look that up as well.
